title: [EX-00] Averill excellence: intuitive navigation and useful grounded AI
body:
## Problem Statement

Employees cannot reliably find the right action or obtain clear relevant answers without a test guide. Main Averill and its Canva companion present long content sequences, while tool help, company lookup, synthesis and public checking are conflated.

## Solution

Deliver the approved excellence plan as sixteen dependency-linked increments covering context correctness, answer evaluation, intent/retrieval, public checking, desktop/Canva navigation, learning, accessibility and real acceptance.

## User Stories

1. As an employee, I want to find Ask immediately, so that I can work independently and understand the result.
2. As an employee, I want to start a work check, so that I can work independently and understand the result.
3. As an employee, I want to find public research, so that I can work independently and understand the result.
4. As an employee, I want to ask in natural Italian or English, so that I can work independently and understand the result.
5. As an employee, I want to continue a prior task, so that I can work independently and understand the result.
6. As an employee, I want to receive short relevant tool instructions, so that I can work independently and understand the result.
7. As an employee, I want to receive faithful summaries, so that I can work independently and understand the result.
8. As an employee, I want to receive useful drafts, so that I can work independently and understand the result.
9. As an employee, I want to recognize company authority, so that I can work independently and understand the result.
10. As an employee, I want to inspect exact evidence, so that I can work independently and understand the result.
11. As an employee, I want to get a precise recovery action, so that I can work independently and understand the result.
12. As an employee, I want to navigate indexed conversations, so that I can work independently and understand the result.
13. As an employee, I want to find current document versions, so that I can work independently and understand the result.
14. As an employee, I want to use one quiet Canva panel, so that I can work independently and understand the result.
15. As an employee, I want to follow one guide step at a time, so that I can work independently and understand the result.
16. As an employee, I want to understand current measurements, so that I can work independently and understand the result.
17. As an employee, I want to keep learning private, so that I can work independently and understand the result.
18. As an employee, I want to use keyboard and screen reader, so that I can work independently and understand the result.
19. As an employee, I want to stop sharing at any time, so that I can work independently and understand the result.
20. As an employee, I want to avoid private content in public searches, so that I can work independently and understand the result.

## Implementation Decisions

- Preserve the approved Companion identity, source authority, existing consent and bounded observation contracts.
- Implement dependency-linked EX-01 through EX-16.
- Keep existing parent and acceptance issues untouched.
- Treat the audit observations as hypotheses to reproduce where root causes remain unknown.

## Testing Decisions

- Test observable behavior and employee-visible results, not private implementation structure. Prefer the existing authenticated renderer/IPC question → outbound preview → answer seam, following the Pro renderer and contextual bridge prior art. Preserve isolated synthetic accounts; company/public evidence, Stop/logout and content-bound consent are mandatory. The owner confirmed these testing seams on 30 October 2026.
- Real providers, installed Canva/Brevo, VoiceOver and independent human usability remain separate gates.

## Out of Scope

Autonomous send, export or publication; arbitrary desktop observation or control; new screenshot/OCR permissions; automatic source approvals; cross-person memory; real employee data in Tavily; replacing human usability or real-platform acceptance with synthetic tests.

## Further Notes

Owner requested specification publication and implementation on 30 October 2026. Completion of a ticket requires evidence against that ticket, not merely creation of this epic.

title: [EX-01] Context and authority correctness
body:
## Problem Statement

An email can be checked as Canva text, stale Learn errors contradict progress, and document labels can contradict their authority.

## Solution

Show the correct current work type, current learning state and unambiguous source authority.

## User Stories

1. As an employee, I want to recognize the shared email as email, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
2. As an employee, I want to see when a selected work type is an explicit override, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
3. As an employee, I want to reset an override when the shared context changes, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
4. As an employee, I want to see current measurements separately from history, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
5. As an employee, I want to see learning errors clear after the condition changes, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
6. As an employee, I want to understand which steps still need attention, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
7. As an employee, I want to distinguish personal notes from company policy, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
8. As an employee, I want to see approval conflicts sent for explicit review, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
9. As an employee, I want to keep existing approvals unchanged during diagnosis, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
10. As an employee, I want to recover without reading an internal exception, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.

## Implementation Decisions

- Reproduce each audit observation in an isolated workspace before fixing it.
- Bind inferred work type and explicit override to the observed identity.
- Keep approval metadata authoritative; flag contradictory content rather than auto-approving or revoking sources.
- Model current measurements separately from historical progress and transient errors.

## Testing Decisions

- Context changes, rule-set selection and learning/authority recovery; reproduce email versus Canva mismatch and stale measurement/error cases.
- Test observable behavior and employee-visible results, not private implementation structure. Prefer the existing authenticated renderer/IPC question → outbound preview → answer seam, following the Pro renderer and contextual bridge prior art. Preserve isolated synthetic accounts; company/public evidence, Stop/logout and content-bound consent are mandatory. The owner confirmed these testing seams on 30 October 2026.

## Out of Scope

Autonomous send, export or publication; arbitrary desktop observation or control; new screenshot/OCR permissions; automatic source approvals; cross-person memory; real employee data in Tavily; replacing human usability or real-platform acceptance with synthetic tests.

## Further Notes

Ticket: EX-01. No prerequisites within this program.

Part of the owner-approved Averill excellence plan from the 29 October audit. This issue specifies work; publication is not a completion claim. Existing acceptance issues and parent issues remain unchanged.

title: [EX-02] Answer quality baseline and regression corpus
body:
## Problem Statement

Passing transport and unit tests does not show whether ordinary questions produce useful answers.

## Solution

Measure intent, relevance, completeness, evidence and recovery using realistic tasks.

## User Stories

1. As an employee, I want to ask natural Italian questions, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
2. As an employee, I want to ask English paraphrases, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
3. As an employee, I want to make a common spelling mistake, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
4. As an employee, I want to ask without naming the tool, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
5. As an employee, I want to continue a previous task, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
6. As an employee, I want to request several improvements at once, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
7. As an employee, I want to receive an actionable answer when sources are missing, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
8. As an employee, I want to see limitations rather than fabricated verification, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
9. As an employee, I want to have private data excluded from public search, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
10. As an employee, I want to have failures categorized by their actual cause, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
11. As an employee, I want to benefit from unseen evaluation paraphrases, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
12. As an employee, I want to trust that synthetic tests are not called human acceptance, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.

## Implementation Decisions

- Create an 80-case evaluation catalogue spanning policy, tool help, visual review, drafts, summaries/comparisons, public research, follow-ups and failure/privacy/context.
- Separate implemented regression assertions from planned evaluation cases; retain baseline failures honestly.
- Reserve unseen paraphrases for holdout evaluation; do not tune all examples into keyword patterns.
- Store synthetic fixtures and content-free aggregate results, not real employee questions.

## Testing Decisions

- Prefer existing assistant renderer/IPC and authenticated contextual flows; add lower-level tests only for security/lifecycle contracts that cannot be exercised reliably above them.
- Test observable behavior and employee-visible results, not private implementation structure. Prefer the existing authenticated renderer/IPC question → outbound preview → answer seam, following the Pro renderer and contextual bridge prior art. Preserve isolated synthetic accounts; company/public evidence, Stop/logout and content-bound consent are mandatory. The owner confirmed these testing seams on 30 October 2026.

## Out of Scope

Autonomous send, export or publication; arbitrary desktop observation or control; new screenshot/OCR permissions; automatic source approvals; cross-person memory; real employee data in Tavily; replacing human usability or real-platform acceptance with synthetic tests.

title: [EX-03] Natural intent and current task continuity
body:
## Problem Statement

Natural tool requests, summaries and short follow-ups can fall into company lookup and dead-end answers.

## Solution

Understand the task and carry only relevant current context, with a useful clarification when needed.

## User Stories

1. As an employee, I want to describe putting a photo inside a shape, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
2. As an employee, I want to ask whether selected text is readable, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
3. As an employee, I want to ask how to change a color without repeating Canva, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
4. As an employee, I want to say “and on Instagram?” after a task, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
5. As an employee, I want to ask for a summary without receiving a company lookup, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
6. As an employee, I want to ask for differences between versions, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
7. As an employee, I want to ask several related goals without losing one, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
8. As an employee, I want to ask for a company requirement without receiving optional advice as policy, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
9. As an employee, I want to switch work contexts without inheriting the wrong topic, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
10. As an employee, I want to ask a follow-up after permissions change and receive fresh context, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
11. As an employee, I want to receive a specific clarification when no tool is known, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
12. As an employee, I want to continue offline without provider calls, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.

## Implementation Decisions

- Keep classification local; no arbitrary question is sent on the closed public-help route.
- Scope continuation to authenticated person, source authority and active work identity.
- Distinguish operational help, policy, draft, summary, comparison, research and review.
- Preserve explicit company rules and content-bound consent.

## Testing Decisions

- Question to preview to answer in the existing renderer/IPC; authenticated browser flow for selected-field and follow-up behavior.
- Test observable behavior and employee-visible results, not private implementation structure. Prefer the existing authenticated renderer/IPC question → outbound preview → answer seam, following the Pro renderer and contextual bridge prior art. title: [EX-04] Complete permission-aware source retrieval
body:
## Problem Statement

Substring matching and prefix truncation can miss relevant approved information and confuse languages or versions.

## Solution

Find the relevant passage across complete eligible documents with precise provenance.

## User Stories

1. As an employee, I want to find a passage near the end of a long document, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
2. As an employee, I want to ask in Italian about English sources, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
3. As an employee, I want to search using a familiar synonym, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
4. As an employee, I want to receive the current approved version, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
5. As an employee, I want to avoid inaccessible department material, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
6. As an employee, I want to avoid restricted sources in model input, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
7. As an employee, I want to see conflicting versions explained, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
8. As an employee, I want to open a precise supporting passage, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
9. As an employee, I want to keep source identity stable across search, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
10. As an employee, I want to receive a useful missing-evidence explanation, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.

## Implementation Decisions

title: [EX-05] Shared answer contract and useful grounded responses
body:
## Problem Statement

Exact excerpts, provider status and generic prose are presented without a reliable intent-specific answer structure.

## Solution

Return a concise useful answer, traceable evidence and one appropriate next action.

## User Stories

1. As an employee, I want to receive a direct policy answer, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
2. As an employee, I want to receive short relevant tool instructions, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
3. As an employee, I want to receive a complete reviewed draft, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
4. As an employee, I want to receive a faithful multi-passage summary, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
5. As an employee, I want to compare versions in a readable structure, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
6. As an employee, I want to understand which requested goals remain unanswered, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
7. As an employee, I want to see conditional exceptions only when relevant, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
8. As an employee, I want to open exact supporting evidence, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
9. As an employee, I want to recognize general guidance versus company authority, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
10. As an employee, I want to get usable local help when online output fails, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
11. As an employee, I want to avoid raw validator or IPC errors, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
12. As an employee, I want to review every supported edit before applying it, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.

## Implementation Decisions

- Use a shared typed answer envelope consumed by desktop and companion.
- Extend existing public schema rather than introducing a parallel client.
- Keep exact citation checks while allowing validated faithful synthesis in the relevant intent.
- Validate claim support, negations, numbers, conditions, coverage and context freshness.
- Render actions only from local allowlists; model prose is never executable code or an edit.
- Use bounded repair and readable fallback; preserve total call/time budgets.

## Testing Decisions

- Real renderer/IPC answer presentation with synthetic providers; adversarial evidence/claim cases and separate live-provider corpus.
- Test observable behavior and employee-visible results, not private implementation structure. Prefer the existing authenticated renderer/IPC question → outbound preview → answer seam, following the Pro renderer and contextual bridge prior art. title: [EX-06] Public claim decomposition and relevant Tavily evidence
body:
## Problem Statement

A whole campaign sentence can return travel links that do not establish the company offer.

## Solution

Check public atomic facts using the right evidence and explain what cannot be confirmed.

## User Stories

1. As an employee, I want to separate a public fact from a private offer, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
2. As an employee, I want to review the exact public search query, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
3. As an employee, I want to confirm each outgoing public statement, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
4. As an employee, I want to retain date and location qualifiers, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
5. As an employee, I want to see same-entity evidence, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
6. As an employee, I want to distinguish not found from contradicted, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
7. As an employee, I want to understand why a result is inconclusive, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
8. As an employee, I want to see a source excerpt supporting a verdict, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
9. As an employee, I want to avoid irrelevant commercial travel results, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
10. As an employee, I want to keep internal draft text out of public queries, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
11. As an employee, I want to cancel without any provider request, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.
12. As an employee, I want to review a changed query before it is transmitted, so that I can complete my work confidently without a test guide.

## Implementation Decisions

- Decompose claims locally within confirmed text and preserve qualifiers.
- Do not send new queries under stale content-bound consent.
- Use bounded Tavily subqueries and relevance checks, with Nemotron judging only supplied public evidence where allowed.
- Company campaign authority comes from approved accessible sources, not unrelated public offers.

## Testing Decisions

- Confirmed claim to outbound preview to verdict in the existing public-check flow, with unrelated/contradictory/unavailable evidence fixtures.
- Test observable behavior and employee-visible results, not private implementation structure. Prefer the existing authenticated renderer/IPC question → outbound preview → answer seam, following the Pro renderer and contextual bridge prior art. Preserve isolated synthetic accounts; company/public evidence, Stop/logout and content-bound consent are mandatory. The owner confirmed these testing seams on 30 October 2026.

## Out of Scope
